name: 席力图召及家庙
title: 席力圖召
text: 席力图召（蒙古语：ᠰᠢᠷᠡᠭᠡᠲᠦ ᠵᠤᠤ，汉语拼音字母：Xireet Jûû），位于内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市玉泉区石头巷，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。席力图召是呼和浩特市的“七大召”之一。

image.title: Xilitu_Zhao_(53725401566).jpg
image.author: xiquinhosilva
image.caption: The Xilitu Zhao, also referred to as Shiretu Juu or formally as Yanshou Temple, is a historic Tibetan Buddhist monastery belonging to the Gelugpa school. Located in Hohhot, the capital of Inner Mongolia, China, the monastery was originally constructed in 1585. It was subsequently destroyed by fire and reconstructed in the 19th century.
